name: Lowndes County, GA
findings: Lowndes County has 318 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lowndes County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 18 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 37 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
